notes: Program-supplied content. Bump 'version' whenever you change anything below. Every item needs a permanent unique 'id' starting with 'p-'. Users receive new/changed items on their next visit unless they turned on 'Ignore new program content'. Items a user deleted never come back; items a user edited are never overwritten.

templates.name: Standard welcome & disclaimer
templates.content:
Welcome, PAX! Any FNGs here today?
Quick disclaimer: I'm not a professional. This is a free, peer-led workout. You participate at your own risk. Modify as needed — keep your head on a swivel and look out for each other.
Phones are out for emergencies. Mission: plant, grow and serve small workout groups for men for the invigoration of male community leadership.

templates.name: Classic Warm-O-Rama
templates.content:
Mosey around the AO to loosen up
SSH x 20 IC
Imperial Walkers x 15 IC
Windmills x 10 IC
Grass Grabbers x 10 IC
Little Baby Arm Circles forward/back x 10 IC
Abe Vigodas x 10 IC
Mountain Climbers x 15 IC

templates.name: Dynamic mobility warm-up
templates.content:
Mosey with high knees / butt kickers / karaoke on the way
SSH x 15 IC
World's Greatest Stretch x 5 each side
Tappy Taps x 10 IC
Seal Jacks x 15 IC
Downward dog → Upward dog x 5

templates.name: 11s
templates.content:
Two exercises at opposite ends (~50 yds apart).
Start with 10 reps of exercise A, run, 1 rep of exercise B.
Run back: 9 of A, run, 2 of B … continue until 1 of A / 10 of B.
Suggested pair: Merkins / Squats.

templates.name: Dora 1-2-3
templates.content:
Partner up. P1 runs to the far marker and back while P2 chips away at the reps; flapjack.
100 Merkins
200 LBCs
300 Squats

templates.name: Coupon ladder
templates.content:
Grab a coupon. Mosey 25 yds between cones.
Cone 1: 5 Curls
Cone 2: 5 Curls + 5 Overhead Press
Cone 3: 5 Curls + 5 OHP + 5 Goblet Squats
Cone 4: + 5 Coupon Rows
Work back down the ladder. Repeat until time.

templates.name: Mary circle
templates.content:
Circle up. Each PAX calls an exercise, 10–15 IC:
LBCs, Flutter Kicks, American Hammers, Freddie Mercury, Box Cutters, Dying Cockroach, Plank hold to finish.

templates.name: Modification reminder
templates.content: Remind PAX to modify as needed. Keep the 6 in mind — circle back for anyone falling behind.
